What is Adamantine Lions?

The Adamantine Lions is a Loyalist Space Marine Chapter of unknown Founding and genetic origin.

The Adamantine Lions' Chapter colours are not listed in current Imperial records.

The Adamantine Lions' Chapter badge is not listed in current Imperial records.
